```{octave}
#| warning: false 

% Set up environment

clear all;

%% Avoid throwing warning by loading the "statistics" package:
warning('off', 'Octave:shadowed-function');

%% Load packages:
pkg load statistics
pkg load io


% Read in data:
raw       = csv2cell('dat/Mixed Effects Models/mixed-stata_protzko.csv');
var_names = raw(1, :);
data      = cell2struct(raw(2:end, :), var_names, 2);

% Select variables
loyal = [data.loyal]';
squo  = [data.squo]';
scen  = [data.scenario]';
id    = [data.id]';

% Mixed-effects model fitting - Scenario 1:
  
%% Ancillary objects:
n          = length(data);
intercepts = [ones(n, 1), squo];      % fixed intercept + fixed slope of squo
random     = {intercepts, ones(n,1)}; % id: intercept + squo slope; scenario: intercept
group      = {categorical(id), categorical(scen)};

% The lines after the first one only assign names to the variables, but do not
%   affect the default behavior of the estimation algorithm:
lme = fitlmematrix(intercepts, loyal, random, group, ...
                   'FixedEffectPredictors', {'Intercept','squo'}, ...
                   'RandomEffectPredictors', ...
                   {{'Intercept','squo'}, {'Intercept'}}, ...
                   'RandomEffectGroups', {'id','scenario'});

lme % Output model diagnostics.
```
